csv_project_name: Design & Install for Bldg 210 Generator Protection System
csv_scope_of_work: Contractor support to design, deliver, and install a physical and visual safeguarding system to protect Building 210 s backup generator. The mission is to protect these assets from emerging localized aerial threats, specifically denying visual reconnaissance and preventing kinetic damage from off-the-shelf unmanned aerial systems (UAS), ensuring uninterrupted power generation for mission-critical base operations
